analysis: The context: the substring call `address.substring(1, address.length() - 1)` occurs inside an `if` block that checks `address.length() > 2` and `address.charAt(address.length() - 1) == ']'`. This ensures the length is at least 3, so `address.length()-1` is at least 2 and less than the length. The beginIndex is 1 (non-negative) and less than endIndex (since length-1 > 1 when length>2). All conditions that would cause IndexOutOfBoundsException are avoided by these checks.
remark: The substring call is guarded by address.length() > 2, so beginIndex=1 is non-negative, endIndex=address.length()-1 is less than length, and beginIndex < endIndex. Therefore, no exception can be thrown.
